name: Eventa
des: Eventa an event management and ticketing web application built with Next.js, TypeScript, Redux and Ant Design. This platform provides different panels for Event Organizers and Attendees. Organizers can create, manage, and advertise events, track attendees, and control ticket availability in real-time. Attendees can browse events, purchase tickets, and view their booking history. Secure payment integration (e.g., AmarPay, bKash) ensures smooth and reliable transactions.Includes features like RSVP management, guest onboarding, and real-time updates, ensuring a seamless experience for both sides.

imgDes.featureDes: The Explore page immerses users in a curated showcase of event categories and platform capabilities. Users can browse featured areas like Entertainment, Professional, Cultural, Sports & Recreation, Fundraising & Charity, and Socials & Parties, each accompanied by an 'Explore Events' call-to-action—making discovery intuitive and visually appealing

The Event Details page provides attendees with all the essential information about a specific event in a clear and engaging way. It displays the event name, date, time, and venue, supported by an integrated interactive map so users can easily locate the event. A detailed event description offers context and highlights what participants can expect, while the available ticket information is shown alongside secure booking options.

The Create Event page is designed to make event setup simple and efficient for organizers. It allows users to add a new event by providing key details such as the event name, description, date and time, venue location, and category. With an intuitive form layout and interactive fields, organizers can accurately define all aspects of their event, ensuring clarity for potential attendees.

imgDes.featureTitle: Eventa Add tickets to the events
imgDes.featureDes: The Add Tickets page allows event organizers to configure and manage ticketing options for their events. Organizers can define ticket names, pricing, available quantity, sales period, and validity timeframe, ensuring flexibility for different event types. This feature provides attendees with transparent ticket information while giving organizers full control over how and when tickets are sold.

The User Dashboard provides event organizers with a comprehensive overview of their activities and performance. It displays the user’s name, total events, approved, pending, and rejected events, as well as total tickets sold and orders. The dashboard also includes financial reports and visual analytics, giving users clear insights into sales trends, attendee engagement, and overall event performance all in one intuitive interface for efficient management and decision-making.
